title: Universal presentation of algebraic-space relative differentials
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of algebraic spaces over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], and use their canonical morphism of small etale ringed topoi [lem-trf-space-enlarged-etale-ringed-site-model]. A universal differential presentation consists of an $\mathcal O_X$-module sheaf $\Omega$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] on the existing small etale site and a derivation $d:\mathcal O_X\to\Omega$ relative to the canonical structure map $f^{-1}\mathcal O_Y\to\mathcal O_X$, such that for every $\mathcal O_X$-module sheaf $N$ the map $\operatorname{Hom}(\Omega,N)\to\operatorname{Der}_{f^{-1}\mathcal O_Y}(\mathcal O_X,N)$, $h\mapsto h\circ d$, is bijective. This presents the relative differential sheaf of [def-sfb-sheaf-differentials] on the full small etale site in the original section universe, up to its unique isomorphism preserving $d$. The record is presentation data only and asserts no existence, finiteness, or smoothness property.
